kept.title: Overlay snapshot is authoritative for task structure; the native file is a live echo
kept.summary: When buildGraph first sees a Claude native task it adopts a frozen snapshot ({subject, description, status, blockedBy, owner, metadata, snapshotted_at}) into overlay.snapshots; that snapshot — not the native .json file — is authoritative for structure. When the native file is later removed by the cleanupPeriodDays retention sweep, aggregateWorkspace falls back to the snapshot, so tasks don't vanish from the graph. Editing only the native file won't necessarily win.

kept.title: status:'ready' is a SENTINEL in overlay sync meaning 'override cleared', not a real status
kept.summary: emitDiff writes status_changed -> 'ready' for any task whose status override is ABSENT in the new overlay but present in prev (i.e. the override was deleted, e.g. on releaseClaim). On rehydrate the code explicitly skips node.status === 'ready' so the sentinel is never persisted back as a real status. Treating 'ready' as a stored status value will corrupt the diff logic.

kept.title: Incremental edge-judge gates on epoch / judgedAtEpoch / judgeCursor — not on cosine alone
kept.summary: overlay.epoch is a monotonic counter bumped on every note/task ADD. A note is re-pullable by the edge-judge only when judgedAtEpoch[key] < epoch; a 'no edge' verdict stamps judgedAtEpoch[key]=epoch so it stays out of the queue until the graph actually changes. judgeCursor persists the judge's queue position across daemon restarts so it never re-walks the whole graph. judgedClusters is the node-dedup analogue keyed by cluster signature.

kept.title: Shipped default heartbeat loop controls: 5M token budget, 6250 iters, 30-300s poll, batch 4, conc 6; idle wakeup 7200s
kept.summary: When no loop is active the system tells the agent to call loop_control({action:'start', tokenBudget:5000000, maxIterations:6250, minPoll:30, maxPoll:300, batch:4, maxConcurrency:6}). The idle heartbeat ScheduleWakeup uses delaySeconds=7200 (2h). These exact defaults govern autonomous-loop cost/cadence and can't be guessed off-repo.

kept.title: Heldout bench fixtures encode A/B arms in the directory name: <challenge>-<off|on>-<gated|search|iterative>-<N>
kept.summary: bench/heldout/frozen holds frozen attempt dirs named like api-contract-off-0, claim-task-on-gated-0, bench-metric-on-search-1 — the suffix is the experiment arm (orchestrator off vs on, and the on-mode: gated/search/iterative) plus an index, paired with a per-challenge grader in bench/heldout/graders/<challenge>.grader.js. This is how the self-learn benchmark compares conditions; the naming is the contract.
